item.title: Matan Kahana Elected Speaker of Israel’s Parliament
item.description: Matan Kahana, a lawmaker from Gadi Eisenkot’s party, will take control of the legislative process as the opposition looks to press Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu on multiple fronts. Fuente: The New York Times - World.
item.dc:creator: David M. Halbfinger

item.title: Directo Latam y el viaje de Sheinbaum a China para la cumbre de la APEC
item.description: La presidenta mexicana, Claudia Sheinbaum, viajó a Shenzhen, China, para participar en la cumbre de la APEC, donde previamente se reunió con el presidente Xi Jinping. En su primer viaje al gigante asiático, Sheinbaum busca fortalecer sus lazos con otros países en medio de la presión arancelaria ejercida por el presidente Donald Trump. Nuestro corresponsal Jorge Hurtado nos amplió la información. Fuente: France 24 - Español.
item.dc:creator: FRANCE24

item.title: Caribbean nations fear economic impact of shuttering citizenship program after EU threats
item.description: St Kitts and Nevis to wind down citizenship-by-investment program after EU warns of end to visa-free access The decision by St Kitts and Nevis to end a lucrative programme offering citizenship to wealthy foreigners in exchange for investment threatens its economy and ability to support people in need, the premier of the island of Nevis has warned. On Friday, Terrance Drew, the prime minister of the twin-island Caribbean nation, announced he would wind down the citizenship-by-investment (CBI) programme, after the European Union threatened to end visa-free access for St Kitts and Nevis… Fuente: The Guardian - World.
item.dc:creator: Natricia Duncan Caribbean correspondent

item.title: Panamá: Mulino evalúa volver a activar la mina de cobre a cielo abierto más grande de Centroamérica
item.description: El presidente panameño, Raúl Mulino, anunció que su Gobierno iniciará las conversaciones con la filial canadiense First Quantum para reactivar los trabajos en la mina de cobre a cielo abierto más grande de Centroamérica. El complejo, en pausa desde 2023 luego de que la Justicia encontrara irregularidades en el contrato de concesión, tiene unas 3.000 toneladas de cobre. Fuente: France 24 - Español.
item.dc:creator: FRANCE24

item.title: As Trump walks into a summit of strongmen, what can America’s lame-duck president hope to achieve?
item.description: Devoid of political capital, Donald Trump is embarking on a historic summit that may have no point apart from his own self-soothing, Andrew Feinberg writes Fuente: The Independent - World.
item.dc:creator: Andrew Feinberg

item.title: Israeli parliament elects Eisenkot ally Matan Kahana as speaker in blow for Netanyahu
item.description: The Israeli parliament on Tuesday elected as new speaker an ally of Gadi Eisenkot, the party leader currently working to form the next government and replace current Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu. Matan Kahana, a former special forces soldier, is expected as soon as Wednesday to start the process of undoing much of the agenda of Netanyahu. Fuente: France 24 - English.
item.dc:creator: FRANCE 24

item.title: AI imagery complicates Nigeria's election prep
item.description: In tonight's edition, concerns emerge that AI has been used to generate fake voting profiles ahead of Nigeria's high-stakes general election in January. Also, Nigeria's mining marshal heads underground to unearth some of the people and organizations behind the vast illegal mining industries. And a groundbreaking archaeological discovery in northern Sudan could be the ancient site of the largest church ever built in one of medieval Nubia's most important Christian sites. Fuente: France 24 - English.

item.title: Major setbacks for Netanyahu ahead of vote to name new Knesset speaker
item.description: Since suffering heavy losses in Israel’s Oct. 27 election, Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's party has repeatedly claimed the vote was “stolen” by Arab-led parties, possibly with foreign assistance. Those claims appear to be crumbling as he tries to cling to power, as the Israeli parliament is set to select a new speaker opposed to him. FRANCE 24's Noga Tarnopolsky reports from Jerusalem. Fuente: France 24 - English.
item.dc:creator: FRANCE24

item.title: Mozambique opposition leader charged with terrorism over 2024 unrest
item.description: Mozambique's opposition leader Venâncio Mondlane is facing terrorism charges as his trial opens, reigniting tensions over the disputed 2024 elections. He previously led months of protests, met with a violent crackdown that left at least 400 people dead, according to civil society groups. Fuente: Africanews.

item.title: Authorities take over Turkey's last pro-opposition broadcaster Sozcu TV
item.description: Police raided the Istanbul headquarters of Sozcu TV on Tuesday, dealing another significant blow to Turkey's pro-opposition media. This is the third such seizure of pro-opposition media in just over a year. It comes amid public uproar over a multi-billion investment fund scandal that has affected the savings of nearly half a million people and piled pressure on President Recep Tayyip Erdogan's ruling AKP party ahead of elections in 2028. FRANCE 24's Jasper Mortimer reports from Ankara. Fuente: France 24 - English.

item.description: Brazilian President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva came up with the idea for the meeting between US President Donald Trump, Chinese President Xi Jinping and Russian President Vladimir Putin, Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney said on Monday, days before the three leaders were due to meet in Shenzhen. “He told me yesterday that he had encouraged this meeting to help bring about an end to the war in Ukraine,” Carney told reporters on the sidelines of the Francophonie summit in Phnom Penh. item.title: The centre cannot hold? Splintered moderates lag in French presidential race
item.description: Five months to go before the French vote in the presidential election first round to choose Emmanuel Macron’s successor. Not much of a race so far for the top two spots and the May Second runoff: there’s the far-right’s Marine Le Pen, the far-left’s Jean-Luc Mélenchon and way behind there’s the rest. Whether on social media or in the streets, their supporters rule. A radical break with the mainstream. Fuente: France 24 - English.

item.description: La Knéset (el parlamento israelí) se inclina por nombrar a Matan Kahana como nuevo presidente en sustitución del diputado del Likud Amir Ohana. Kahana, del partido Yashar, de Gadi Eisenkot, partió en la jornada de votación con el apoyo de los cuatro partidos del bloque contrario a Benjamín Netanyahu y de los partidos árabes de la Lista Conjunta y Raam. En total, 67 de los 120 escaños apostaban por el cambio de presidente y Yousef Jabareen, dirigente de la Lista Conjunta árabe, señaló que «prometimos decidir, prometimos traer el cambio a nuestro público, y lo estamos cumpliendo. Tras recibir varios golpes en el frente interno, el mandatario estadounidense encuentra sosiego en el agasajo de sus anfitriones y busca llevar algunos éxitos de regreso a casa. Fuente: France 24 - Español.

item.description: Jensen Huang, cofundador y ex consejero delegado de Nvidia, ha asegurado que está dispuesto a volver a su cargo en el gigante tecnológico tras su renuncia hace apenas una semana. item.title: Deutsche Bank leaks: German lender's dealings with Russian oligarchs under scrutiny
item.description: Germany's finance minister Tuesday urged "full transparency" from Deutsche Bank after international media outlets published reports based on millions of leaked documents that shine a light on questionable past business practices at the banking giant. They include ties to Russian oligarchs, the convicted sex offender Jeffrey Epstein, and Donald Trump before he became US president. France 24's Douglas Herbert takes a closer look. Fuente: France 24 - English.

item.title: Serbia's student-backed MPs take seats in parliament after election win
item.description: Serbia's Student ⁠List lawmakers entered parliament ​on Tuesday, cheered on by hundreds of supporters, after their October ​election victory ended 14 years of rule by the Serbian Progressive Party (SNS). The Student List, a group that includes academics, professionals, farmers, actors and activists ​chosen ‌by student assemblies, secured 140 seats in the ⁠250-member parliament in October 25 polls, while the SNS gained 104. Fuente: France 24 - English.

item.title: France's Le Pen promises to lower retirement age if she wins election
item.description: French far-right ​leader Marine Le ​Pen vowed on Tuesday to repeal President ​Emmanuel ‌Macron's pension ⁠reform if she is ‌elected next spring and ⁠bring down the retirement age to ​60 to 62. She ‌also set out plans to ‌create a fund worth €900 ​billion ($990.54 billion) to help pay for pensions in ​the long term. It ​would take a generation ​to build up the fund, she added. Fuente: France 24 - English.

item.title: Calls for cooperation as ASEAN summit awaits Trump
item.description: The twice-yearly ASEAN summit of Southeast Asian nations is underway, with major global powers also descending upon the Philippines. It is a crucial moment for the region, as ASEAN leaders look to strengthen their influence and collaboration in an increasingly divided global landscape. The arrival of US President Donald Trump on Tuesday is also being welcomed as well as protested, as Charli James reports. Fuente: France 24 - English.

item.description: Los ministros de Defensa europeos se han reunido en Bruselas para tratar un asunto esencial en su programa como el refuerzo de la ayuda militar a Ucrania. Los ministros han proseguido la discusión que ya empezaron los presidentes y primeros ministros en el Consejo Europeo informal de Dublín en el que se habló sobre todo de la necesidad de que la UE esté representada en las negociaciones entre Rusia y Ucrania que apadrina Estados Unidos. Eso explicaría que en este consejo de ministros, además del titular ucraniano, haya participado también el «numero dos» del Pentágono, el subsecretario de… Fuente: ABC España - Internacional.

item.title: Informe desde Shenzhen: Canadá y China se acercan con miras a reducir su dependencia de EE. UU.
item.description: China y Canadá se acercan previo a la cumbre de la APEC que se realizará en Shenzhen. Con los aranceles de Donald Trump como un punto en común, el presidente Xi Jinping y el primer ministro Mark Carney estrechan sus lazos tras rebajar los aranceles a las exportaciones canadienses de carne de cerdo y pescado y los productos chinos de aluminio y acero para reducir la dependencia de ambos países hacia Washington. Nuestro enviado especial Adrián Foncillas nos amplió la información. Fuente: France 24 - Español.

item.title: A precio de liquidación la tele Samsung que parece más un cuadro que un televisor: tiene 65 pulgadas y pantalla antirreflejos
item.description: Si hay un televisor que destaque sobre todo por su diseño, ese es el Samsung The Frame (LS03F) . Lo curioso de este modelo es que se ha diseñado pensando en que cuente con un formato similar al que vemos en un cuadro para que así también sirva como objeto decorativo. item.description: El premier sostendrá que la salida de la Unión Europea perjudicó el potencial económico nacional. Frente a este diagnóstico, el mandatario buscará estrechar lazos con el bloque continental en materia de seguridad y comercio. Fuente: Clarín - Mundo.

item.title: Israeli opposition accuses Netanyahu of attempted ‘coup’
item.description: Netanyahu's main rival, former army chief of staff Gadi Eisenkot, wrote on Sunday that the caretaker prime minister "cannot remain at the head of the government for a minute longer". Publicado también por: The Hindu - International, Euronews. Fuente: Al Jazeera English.
